# Getting help with ChromIQ

- **Bugs**: [open a bug report](https://github.com/itsab1989/ChromIQ/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). The form asks for the version, OS, ArgyllCMS install, and repro steps — please include the in-app log panel contents or the log file (`~/Library/Logs/ChromIQ/chromiq.log` on macOS, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ChromIQ\Logs\` on Windows).
- **Feature ideas**: [open a feature request](https://github.com/itsab1989/ChromIQ/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Questions or open-ended discussion**: use [Discussions](https://github.com/itsab1989/ChromIQ/discussions) — the issue tracker is reserved for actionable bug reports and feature requests.
- **ArgyllCMS itself**: colour-science questions belong on the [ArgyllCMS mailing list](https://www.argyllcms.com/) — ChromIQ is only a GUI front-end and can't fix Argyll behaviour.

You can also reach the bug-report form directly from inside the app — open **Preferences** (⌘,) and click **Report a Bug…** in the bottom row.
